description:
Welcome to Strong & Ready — practical safety for men over 60 living on their own.

When the power goes out, a storm hits, or something breaks at 2 AM, there's no one else to handle it — it's on you. Here you'll find simple, no-nonsense guidance: blackout preparation, home safety, emergency plans, and everyday habits that keep you independent and in control.

What you'll find here: power outage readiness, winter storm safety, home emergency basics, and practical tips for men living alone after 60.

This channel shares general educational information only — not professional, legal, or medical advice. If a video helps you, share it with someone who lives alone too.
